title.narrative: US Special Pooled Account - 2023 Recommendation implementation through the GHA

description.narrative: Under the overarching framework of the 2023 Recommendation, mainstreaming the General History of Africa into education systems in Africa and around the world is both a tool and a catalyst for transformative education. By providing all learners with a broad understanding of African history, and promoting knowledge, skills, values and attitudes that defy hegemonic knowledge systems and racial biases, the GHA can contribute to forging a united, prosperous and peaceful Africa and world. To support countries in these efforts, UNESCO is developing a Resource Pack for the mainstreaming of the GHA into education systems. During 2026–2027 the focus will be on finalizing the core components of the Resource Pack, including the pedagogical pathway and thematic guidebooks, as well as providing targeted national support to countries that have committed to advancing this work. Efforts will also prioritize the development of easily accessible tools for teachers, such as an online course, alongside strengthened advocacy initiatives, including videos, webinars and events highlighting the importance of the initiative.
